description: Pure shared module shared/models/contactPhoneValue.ts holding phonePattern, normalizePhoneForSearch and checkContactPhoneNumberValue, moved unchanged from contactModel.ts; ContactModel.validatePhoneNumbers uses it with identical errors (D3).

parseEntraPhoneValue(raw) splits a trailing ;ext=, ' ext', ' ext.' or x<digits> marker into phoneNumber and extension; extension outside 1-10 digits is dropped and reported as discardedExtension (D1, D2).

buildEntraContactPhoneRows(user) returns rows plus notices; rows that still fail checkContactPhoneNumberValue are skipped, is_default/display_order recomputed; buildEntraContactPhoneNumbers returns its rows (D4, D7).
detectContactFieldChanges compares extension as well as phone_number and canonical_type.

executeEntraSync guards each user (syncOneEntraUser), records EntraSyncUserIssue failures with stage match|link|create, counts failed, increments created/linked only after the contact write, and returns userIssues including phone notices (D5).

failed and userIssues flow through EntraTenantSyncResult, the run summary in all three workflows, and are persisted to new entra_sync_run_tenants columns failed_count and user_issues (capped at 100) via a migration (D6).

entraWorkflowClient and syncResultSerializer expose failed and userIssues; the sync history panel and console last-run table show 'N contacts failed' and the issue list; completed with failures is a warning outcome (D6).
